handoffs.message: BFF handoff packet complete (commit badf0ce1). Packet covers: BFF query gaps for drill 1 (source-to-health) and drill 2 (runtime-to-incident-to-evolution-proposal), operator journey step sequences, frontend handoff materials (truth labels, degraded-state rules, panel readiness), and acceptance checklist. Please verify that the BFF query gap list in Section 3 matches BFF_SURFACE_INVENTORY.md and BFF_API_CONTRACT.md — if any gap is already implemented, mark it implemented with the commit/PR; if any gap is missing from the listed dependency tasks, flag as blocker before BFF-004 drills can run.

Review approved: all 7 BFF query gaps confirmed genuine against BFF_SURFACE_INVENTORY.md and BFF_API_CONTRACT.md; no gaps are already implemented; no dependency task is missing; two additional filter field gaps (IN-01 runtime_id, EV-01 incident_id) noted for Claude2 pre-drill; packet returned to Claude for closeout
